Name: Produce to Sapling - Ridgeside for PFM
Author: knightjeran
Description:
Adapted from [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5075]Metalax's Produce to Sapling - Vanilla mod[/url][/b], as they give permission for modifications, updates, etc. I use their other produce-to-sapling mods but really wanted one for Ridgeside Village. I take no credit for this mod, I simply adapted it to work with the Ridgeside saplings and produce.

[b][i]As such, this description is also from the original mod author but updated for Ridgeside:[/i][/b]

Uses the Producer Framework Mod to permit tree produce to be processed into saplings at the seed maker.

One additional sapling is given for each quality level.

[list]
[*]Regular: 1
[*]Silver: 2
[*]Gold: 3
[*]Iridium: 4
[/list]
This mod covers all tree produce from the 'Ridgeside Village' mod.

[size=4]Installation:[/size]
[list]
[*] Install [url=https://www.smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿
[*] Unzip the download and move the [code][PFM] Produce to Sapling - Ridgeside[/code]
folder into [code]../Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].[*] Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*] Created with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Windows. Should be fine on Linux/Mac.
[*] Due to PFM only permitting one active rule for each combo of input and
machine, if any other PFM mods that add 'Ridgeside' tree produce interactions with the seed maker are installed, only the first one loaded will function.[/list]
